rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for discarded material, rubbish, or garbage.

example.english: Remember to throw away the refuse after eating.
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 je5 gei3 dak1 diu6 laap6 saap3

rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice when someone is unwilling to do what is asked.

example.english: I asked them to help, but they refuse.
example.traditional: 我叫佢哋幫手，但係佢哋唔肯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 dei6 bong1 sau2 daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 m4 hang2

rows.note: Use this when someone does not agree to or accept a request or demand.

example.english: I asked them if they could reschedule, but they refuse.
example.traditional: 我問佢可唔可以改期，但佢唔答應。
example.jyutping: ngo5 man6 keoi5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 goi2 kei4 daan6 keoi5 m4 daap3 jing3

rows.note: This is the straightforward general verb for refusing a request or refusing to do something, especially in more formal wording.

example.english: The company has the right to refuse my refund request.
example.traditional: 公司有權拒絕我嘅退款申請。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jau5 kyun4 keoi5 zyut6 ngo5 ge3 teoi3 fun2 san1 cing2
